title: Clapping the beats in a word
examples: How many beats are in banana?

explain.say: Clap your hands with me! Words have a beat, just like music. Each beat is called a syllable. Look at the word banana on the board.

draw.text: Clapping the beats in a word

explain.say: The first beat lights up: ba. Clap once. Now put your hand under your chin and say it. Feel your chin drop? That is one beat.
Next beat: na. Clap again, and feel your chin drop again. Two beats so far. Can you guess how many more there are?
One more: na. Clap! Three beats: ba, na, na. Banana has three syllables. Brilliant clapping!
Long words get easy when you clap them in beats. Look at elephant: three beats, three claps. Challenge: clap your own name. How many beats does it have?

faq.a: A syllable is one beat in a word. Cat has one beat. Banana has three.
Clap as you say the word, or put your hand under your chin. Each time your chin drops, that is one beat.
asks: How many beats are in a word?

faq.q: Why does clapping help me read?
faq.a: Long words can look scary. Clapping cuts them into small beats, and small beats are easy to read one at a time.

faq.q: Does every syllable have a vowel?
faq.a: Almost always. Every beat has a vowel sound, made by a, e, i, o or u, and sometimes y, like in my.

faq.q: What can I do instead of clapping?
faq.a: You can stamp, jump, tap the table or tap your fingers. Any move works, as long as you make one move for each beat.
asks: Can I stamp instead of clap?

facts: Every syllable has a vowel sound.
Banana and elephant both have three syllables.

quiz.say: How many syllables are in the word elephant?
quiz.why: El, e, phant: three claps, three syllables.

wrong.0: Clap it again: el, e, phant. That is one more than two.
wrong.2: Elephant has three beats, not four.

quiz.say: Which word has just one syllable?
quiz.why: Dog is one clap, one beat.
